headlines.name: Google makes it easier to use Gemini without training AI on your data
headlines.headline: Google makes it easier to use Gemini without training AI on your data
headlines.description: It can be hard to use Google products—or even the Internet itself—without coming into contact with Gemini AI. That is, of course, by design . The more you use Gemini, the more data Google collects to train and improve its generative AI chatbot. The options to limit training on your data have been scant, but Google is finally adding more controls to the Gemini app.
